name: urls-scheme-is-part-of-the-url
description: The pattern matches case-insensitively and the scheme is lowercased, so HTTPS://Example.com/terms is the evidence URL https://example.com/terms. http://example.com/terms (trailing "!" stripped) has another scheme and is unknown: fires on it.

input.response: Read HTTPS://Example.com/terms or the mirror http://example.com/terms!
